description: Historical incoming-payment ledger for one Monero address, computed with a view key. Returns per-day counts and totals, the largest common amounts, confirmations, unlocked flags and a completion flag for a 1-30 day window. When to use: a merchant or treasury needs to reconcile what actually arrived over a period, not just one txid - the thing a block explorer cannot do for Monero because amounts are hidden. Do not use: to check a single payment when you already have a tx key (xmr_verify_payment), or for balances (xmr_wallet_balance). Returns: tx_count, received_total_xmr, daily[], top_amounts[], transfers[], window.complete. The view key can read but never spend; it is used in a single-use view-only wallet and discarded.

view_key.description: 64 hex char private view key (read-only, cannot spend)
